description: This file defines a GUI dialog class 'ExclusionMatrix' for managing a behaviors exclusion matrix in the BORIS software. It includes UI setup, button handlers for selecting/deselecting behaviors, and methods for updating checkboxes based on user interaction.

classes.name: ExclusionMatrix
classes.description: A dialog window for managing mutual exclusions between behaviors in BORIS.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the exclusion matrix dialog, sets up UI components and layout.

methods.name: pb_selected
methods.description: Checks or unchecks checkboxes in selected cells based on the 'to_check' boolean.

methods.name: pb_cb_selection
methods.description: Selects, unselects, or reverts checkboxes in the entire matrix based on 'mode'.

methods.name: cb_clicked
methods.description: Synchronizes checkbox states between behavior and point behavior lists.
